finding.scope: Release-tag source and official release metadata. The wheel bytes are identified by PyPI SHA-256 but were not downloaded in this execution environment.

basis: PyPI page documents the to_thread tracing surface and release date.
Release-tag source starts the timer/span in trace_to_thread and returns func without invoking it.
Release-tag source still returns the callable from trace_to_thread and records immediately.
The v0.65b0 release notes do not contain the later #4901 repair.
Release notes explicitly list #4901 as the to_thread lifetime/error/repeated-call repair.
Release-tag source returns a functools.wraps wrapper and records around func(*args, **kwargs).

limitations: The exact published wheel bytes could not be downloaded because the execution container has no external DNS path.
Runtime replay uses byte-verified source files from the affected parent and merged-fix commits with compatible installed SDK dependencies; it is not described as whole-wheel execution.
The release boundary is therefore a source-and-release-metadata conclusion, not a claim that every intervening wheel was dynamically exercised.
